camera.focalAreaNote: 0.6 x 0.6 of the frame, centred. Assumed, edit here, never in the gates.

dark.source: Harris skill, dark-register neighbourhood sampled from the Harris original as re-encoded in the 5LunYXCZDFM tutorial at 0:03. Neighbourhood, not exact hexes.
dark.measuredThumbSource: Measured 2026-11-07 from the video's own maxres thumbnail (i.ytimg.com/vi/fUrNOVjWUVM/maxresdefault.jpg, 1280x720, saved verify-seg4/refs/seg4-thumbnail-maxres.jpg): 31px median samples, Africa land #153831/#153530, Europe #123B37, Arabia #133E37, background #182022. This is the thumbnail's palette, NOT the 00:00-00:10 opening frames, which were never obtained. Register is evidenced dark; exact opening hexes remain unmeasured.
dark.baseBorderSource: Spec, not measured. Dark-register base borders must be light to read on #133A35; #14213D is invisible there.
dark.edgeBlurSource: Harris skill, dark register constant edge blur. Value is a spec token, not measured from a reference frame.
dark.grainCompNote: Pre-grain base fills, cycle 2 calibration. The 0.06 grain tile lifts flat fills by about +7.6 per channel (tile median 127.5 x 0.06), so the bases are darker than the measured targets: rendered land #0C3630 -> #133A35, rendered water #111A1C -> #182022. landMeasuredThumb/waterMeasuredThumb stay the measured targets. Measured on v4 draft frames 2026-11-07: rendered land was #1A3F3A and water #1E2527, both about +7 over target.

edgeBlurNote: null until measured from a reference frame. Dark register only, constant edge blur.

floods.source: Harris skill, flat hue-distinct floods. Mustard deepens to #B07C1F on light grounds if G8 needs it.

focus.source: Harris skill, focus system. Non-subject land: saturation x 0.75, value x 0.88.

light.source: Harris skill, palette discipline and brand locks. Water is pale blue, light register, from the Harris study.

tokenScaleNote: Pixel tokens are authored on a 1280x720 grid. Multiply by tokenScale = width / 1280 = 1.5 at 1920x1080. Assumption, kept here, never in the gates.

type.source: Harris skill, typography. Montserrat Bold for geography, Anton display-only.
